questions.stem_text:
In reference to a segment of DNA, which of the following molecules contains the fewest
number of nucleotides?

options.A: the tRNA transcript from the original DNA
options.B: a single strand of the original DNA segment after a substitution mutation
options.C: the final processed mRNA made from the original DNA
options.D: the primary RNA transcript (after splicing) from the original DNA
options.E: a single strand of the original DNA segment after a duplication mutation

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - the tRNA transcript from the original DNA

questions.stem_text: Which of the following statements about mitochondria and chloroplasts is generally true?

options.A: Plants, animals, and fungi all have both chloroplasts and mitochondria.
options.B: Plants and fungi have chloroplasts but no mitochondria; animals have only mitochondria.
options.C: Animals have both chloroplasts and mitochondria; plants and fungi have only chloroplasts.
options.D: Plants and animals have chloroplasts but no mitochondria; fungi have only mitochondria.
options.E: Plants and animals have mitochondria but no chloroplasts; fungi have only chloroplasts.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Plants, animals, and fungi all have both chloroplasts and mitochondria.

questions.stem_text: Starting insulin in type 2 diabetes: continue oral hypoglycemic agents?
questions.answer_explanation: Bedtime NPH insulin added to maximal therapy with sulfonylurea and metformin is an effective, simple, well-tolerated approach for patients with uncontrolled type 2 diabetes.

questions.stem_text: Production of chemokines by perivascular adipose tissue: a role in the pathogenesis of atherosclerosis?
questions.answer_explanation: Human pWAT has chemotactic properties through the secretion of different chemokines, and we propose that pWAT might contribute to the progression of obesity-associated atherosclerosis.

questions.stem_text: The English antibiotic awareness campaigns: did they change the public's knowledge of and attitudes to antibiotic use?
questions.answer_explanation: There is little evidence that the 2008 public antibiotic campaigns were effective. The use and visibility of future campaign materials needs auditing. A carefully planned approach that targets the public in GP waiting rooms and through clinicians in consultations may be a more effective way of improving prudent antibiotic use.

questions.stem_text: Biomolecular identification of allergenic pollen: a new perspective for aerobiological monitoring?
questions.answer_explanation: The real-time PCR approach revealed promising results in pollen identification and quantification, even when analyzing pollen mixes. Future perspectives could concern the development of multiplex real-time PCR for the simultaneous detection of different taxa in the same reaction tube and the application of high-throughput molecular methods.

questions.stem_text: Should temperature be monitorized during kidney allograft preservation?
questions.answer_explanation: The new storage can affords more stable temperature levels when compared to the formerly used can. Since temperature is stable during conservation, continuous monitoring in everyday practice does not seem warranted.
